executionMode: Assembly from completed, explicitly configured measurements
limitations: Each seed starts from the same genuine overseas inquiry checkpoint across its five strategies, not from month zero; the pre-inquiry case is separately labelled.
All policies accept actual incoming offers; only allocations differ. Common production rules may yield different actual production when finances/stock force waiting.
Distant cash may dominate after an upfront procurement contract; the report does not tune the economy to conceal this.
Temporary start/bottle refusals are waiting, not game over. Separate fixed-schedule probes stop on refusal and cannot establish bankruptcy or record capacity.

Price elasticity, unit cost8 and demand6units in the price matrix are explicit synthetic hypotheses. Native price context uses actual pending offers or observed last-three-month purchases; a contract alone adds no demand. No native quote or saved rule changes.
Four-cask production and finite formal record limits remain unchanged. Cached same-process restore timing is not cold-start time; coldSubprocess reports a fresh child and material latency.
